parent_result.result: The frozen v1 model detected 25/38 HAI 23.05 test2 attack windows (65.79%), reached 70.52% point balanced accuracy and 1.891 false alert events/hour. It passed six of seven gates and failed only the 70% attack-window-recall gate.
failure_clusters: P1-CC and P1-TC controller families absent from the 14-window v1 selection split
internal DCS-function attacks whose manipulated internal tags are not present in the 86-signal HAI view
combined and long-duration attacks with weak effects in the aggregated Ferrum state projection
parent_result.immutability: The v1 artifact and final report remain unchanged. HAI 23.05 test2 is now known diagnostic data and can never again be called a final or unseen split.

objective: Test whether a topology-agnostic causal predictor trained on normal traces from two HAI releases generalizes to an untouched older HAI release with broader attack families.

source.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as stated by the repository
source.integrity: The official GitHub API byte size and Git blob SHA-1 were recorded before download. Downloaded gzip files must reproduce both.

model_fit: HAI 23.05 train1 through train3 normal traces
HAI 21.03 train1 and train2 normal traces
model_and_score_selection: HAI 23.05 test1 with 14 known attack windows
HAI 23.05 test2 with 38 now-known attack windows
partition_policy.final_test: All five HAI 21.03 test files, opened together exactly once after candidate selection is committed

schema_policy.signals: Ordered intersection of non-label signals in the HAI 23.05 header and HAI 21.03 normal-training header. Final-file headers may only be checked after candidate selection is committed.
schema_policy.per_domain_normalization: Each release uses medians and 0.5/99.5 percentile ranges fitted only on its registered normal fit files. This is unsupervised domain calibration, not attack-label training.
schema_policy.causality: Only current and past signal/state values may predict the next second. No future values, labels, attack identities or window boundaries may enter a model input.

candidate_families: multivariate temporal ridge over the common signal set
temporal EMA-target JEPA over the common signal set
hybrid score combining causal prediction residual and cross-signal reconstruction residual

fixed_candidate_grid.threshold: First registered quantile whose HAI 21.03 train3 false-alert event rate is at most two per hour
fixed_candidate_grid.alert_rule: At least three threshold exceedances in the trailing five seconds with a 30-second event cooldown

selection_policy.primary: Highest combined HAI 23.05 test1+test2 attack-window recall among candidates passing every gate
tie_breakers: lower normal-calibration false-alert events per hour

required_reporting: false-alert events and seconds per hour
transition baselines and relative error reductions
all preprocessing, retry and dataset-format deviations
authority_boundary: Any v2 model remains advisory. Recorded HIL performance cannot grant permits, block commands, approve goals, invoke adapters or actuate hardware, and is not a Ferrum hardware trial or safety certification.
